info.name: KAIRO API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for KAIRO Backend - AI HR Simulation Platform

## Base URL
Default: `http://localhost:3000`

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer token authentication. Use the Login endpoint first to get a token, which will be automatically saved to the `bearer_token` variable.

## Variables
- `base_url`: Base URL of the API (default: http://localhost:3000)
- `bearer_token`: JWT token for authentication (auto-set after login)
- `session_id`: Current simulation session ID (set after starting simulation)
- `user_id`: Current user ID (set after login)
- `task_id`: Current task ID (for resubmit endpoint)

## Use Cases
1. **Authentication**: Sign up, login, and get current user
2. **Simulation**: Start, manage, and end simulation sessions
3. **Tasks**: Get current task, submit tasks, resubmit tasks, and view all tasks
4. **Interview Management**: Schedule interviews, send emails, view calendar (for hr_t3 task)
5. **Upload**: Upload files and audio
6. **Audio**: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech conversion

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (string, required): Valid email address
- `password` (string, required): Minimum 6 characters
- `name` (string, required): User's full name

**Response:**
- Returns JWT token and user information
- Token is automatically saved to `bearer_token` variable

exec: console.log('✅ Login successful! Token saved to bearer_token variable');

request.description:
Login with email and password to get JWT authentication token.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (string, required): User's email address
- `password` (string, required): User's password

**Response:**
- Returns JWT token and user information
- Token is automatically saved to `bearer_token` variable via post-script
- User ID is saved to `user_id` variable

**Post-Script:**
Automatically extracts token from response and saves it to collection variable `bearer_token` for use in subsequent authenticated requests.

Get current authenticated user's information.

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token in Authorization header

**Response:**
- Returns user details (id, email, name, roleSelected, authProvider)

Google OAuth authentication (stub - not yet implemented).

**Status:**
- Currently returns 501 Not Implemented

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and profile management.

item.name: Simulation

exec: console.log('✅ Simulation started! Session ID saved:', response.sessionId);

request.description:
Start a new simulation session.

**Request Body:**
- `role` (string, required): User's role - must be either "HR Executive" or "Business Analyst"

**Response:**
- Returns session ID, context, welcome message, initial message, and first task
- Session ID is automatically saved to `session_id` variable
- Task ID is saved to `task_id` variable

**Note:**
- Creates a new active simulation session
- Automatically assigns the first task
- Sends initial welcome message from Manager persona (hardcoded)
- Sends initial task assignment message

Get simulation session details and messages.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (string, required): Simulation session ID

**Response:**
- Returns session object with timeline and all messages
- Includes user information and session status

Generate and download final PDF report for a simulation session.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (string, required): Simulation session ID

**Response:**
- Returns PDF file as binary download
- Filename: `kairo-report-{sessionId}.pdf`

**Note:**
- Includes all messages, task submissions, and evaluations
- Comprehensive performance report

End an active simulation session.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (string, required): Simulation session ID

**Response:**
- Marks session as ended
- Updates timeline with session_ended event
- Sets endedAt timestamp

item.description: Simulation session management endpoints for starting, viewing, and ending simulation sessions.

item.name: Tasks

request.description:
Get the current active task for the user's active simulation session.

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token
- Requires active simulation session

**Response:**
- Returns `tasks` array containing all previous tasks (with highest scores) and current pending task
- Returns current task details (id, title, description, level, expectedOutput, status)
- Returns task index
- For hr_t2 task, also returns `resumes` array (10 shared resumes) and `jobDescription` (hardcoded Python Developer JD)
- For hr_t3 task, also returns `candidates` array (4-5 candidates from shared resumes) and `timeSlots` array (available time slots for next 2 weeks)
- Returns null if all tasks are completed

**Note:**
- Resumes are pre-generated and shared across all users
- Job description is hardcoded for Python Developer position
- Time slots are generated for weekdays, 9 AM - 6 PM

request.description:
Submit a task for evaluation.

**Request Body:**
- `text` (string, optional): Text submission content
- `files` (array, optional): Array of file URLs (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT supported)
- `audioUrl` (string, optional): URL to audio file
- `selectedResumes` (array, optional): For hr_t2 task - Array of resume IDs selected
- `resumeRatings` (array, optional): For hr_t2 task - Array of rating objects:
  - `resumeId` (string): Resume ID
  - `rating` (number, 1-10): Rating score
  - `notes` (string, optional): Notes about the candidate
- `interviewIds` (array, optional): For hr_t3 task - Array of interview schedule IDs (should be 3 interviews)
- `emailIds` (array, optional): For hr_t3 task - Array of email IDs sent (should be 6 emails minimum - 3 to candidates + 3 to interviewers)
- `isFinalSubmission` (boolean, optional): For scores 50-70, set to true to proceed despite low score

**Response:**
- Returns submission details with AI evaluation (score 0-10, feedback, improvements)
- Returns `canProceed` (boolean): Whether user can proceed to next task (score >= 5)
- Returns `requiresDecision` (boolean): Whether user needs to decide (score 50-70 in 0-100 scale, not applicable for 0-10)
- Returns `message`: Status message
- Returns `nextTask` if available and score >= 5
- Returns `nextTaskMessage`: AI-generated message for next task
- Returns `completed: true` if all tasks are done
- Returns `scoreInfo`: Score details (min, max, passingScore: 5, currentScore)

**Scoring System (0-10 scale):**
- Score < 5: Rejected, stay on current task
- Score >= 5: Can proceed to next task

**Task-Specific Notes:**
- **hr_t1**: Evaluates job description quality for HR Intern position
- **hr_t2**: Evaluates resume selection against hardcoded Python Developer job description
- **hr_t3**: Evaluates interview scheduling (3 interviews), email quality (resumes attached, meeting links), and clarity (40% + 30% + 30%)

**Note:**
- Automatically evaluates submission using AI
- File contents are extracted and included in evaluation
- For hr_t3, evaluates interview schedules and emails for correct invitations, email quality, and clarity

Resubmit a task to update the score. Allows users to re-upload and improve their submission.

**Path Parameters:**
- `taskId` (string, required): The ID of the task to resubmit

**Request Body:**
- `text` (string, optional): Updated text submission content
- `files` (array, optional): Updated array of file URLs
- `audioUrl` (string, optional): Updated URL to audio file
- `selectedResumes` (array, optional): For hr_t2 task - Updated array of resume IDs
- `resumeRatings` (array, optional): For hr_t2 task - Updated array of rating objects
- `interviewIds` (array, optional): For hr_t3 task - Updated array of interview schedule IDs
- `emailIds` (array, optional): For hr_t3 task - Updated array of email IDs sent

**Response:**
- Returns new submission details with updated AI evaluation
- Returns `isResubmission: true` flag
- Returns `canProceed` (boolean): Whether user can proceed (score >= 5)
- Returns `message`: Status message
- Returns `nextTask` if available and score >= 5
- Returns `nextTaskMessage`: AI-generated message for next task
- Returns `scoreInfo`: Score details

**Note:**
- Creates a new submission record (does not overwrite previous)
- Updates timeline with resubmission event
- Same evaluation logic as initial submission
- Can be called multiple times to improve score

Get all available tasks in the system.

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token

**Response:**
- Returns array of all tasks with details (id, title, description, level, expectedOutput)

**Available Tasks:**
- `hr_t1`: Write a Job Description for an HR Intern (beginner)
- `hr_t2`: Screen 10 resumes & shortlist top 3 candidates (beginner) - Uses Python Developer JD
- `hr_t3`: Schedule Interviews (Calendar + Mail) - Schedule 3 interviews, create calendar invites, send emails with meeting links and resumes (intermediate)
- `hr_t4`: Create a complete HR policy (advanced)

item.description: Task management endpoints for viewing, submitting, and resubmitting tasks during simulation.

item.name: Upload

request.description:
Upload a file to the server.

**Request:**
- Content-Type: multipart/form-data
- Field name: `file`
- Accepts any file type
- Supported file types for content extraction: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT

**Response:**
- Returns file URL, filename, size, and mimetype
- File is stored in S3 or local storage

**Note:**
- Use the returned URL in task submissions
- File contents will be automatically extracted and included in AI evaluation
- Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT

Upload an audio file to the server.

**Request:**
- Content-Type: multipart/form-data
- Field name: `audio`
- Accepts audio file formats

**Response:**
- Returns audio URL, filename, size, and mimetype
- Audio is stored in S3 or local storage

**Note:**
- Use the returned URL in task submissions or speech-to-text requests

item.description: File and audio upload endpoints for submitting documents and audio files.

item.name: Interview Management

request.description:
Get list of candidates available for interview scheduling (for hr_t3 task).

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token
- Requires active simulation session

**Response:**
- Returns array of 4-5 candidates from shared resumes
- Each candidate includes: id, name, email, skills, experience, resumeText

**Note:**
- Candidates are selected from pre-generated shared resumes
- Used for hr_t3 task (Schedule Interviews)

Get available time slots for interview scheduling (for hr_t3 task).

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token
- Requires active simulation session

**Response:**
- Returns array of available time slots for the next 2 weeks
- Time slots are for weekdays only (Monday-Friday)
- Time range: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
- Each slot includes: startTime, endTime, date, duration (60 minutes)

**Note:**
- Used for hr_t3 task (Schedule Interviews)
- Slots are generated dynamically based on current date

request.description:
Schedule an interview with a candidate (for hr_t3 task).

**Request Body:**
- `candidateId` (string, required): Resume ID of the candidate (from candidates list)
- `resumeId` (string, optional): Resume ID to attach in emails (from shared resumes list). If not provided, defaults to candidateId
- `startTime` (string, required): ISO 8601 datetime for interview start
- `endTime` (string, required): ISO 8601 datetime for interview end
- `interviewType` (string, required): Type of interview - "phone", "video", or "in-person"
- `title` (string, optional): Interview title (default: "Interview - Python Developer Position")
- `description` (string, optional): Interview description
- `location` (string, optional): Location for in-person interviews
- `meetingLink` (string, **REQUIRED**): Meeting link for video interviews. **MUST be provided for evaluation**. Format: https://meet.company.com/interview/123456
- `interviewerName` (string, optional): Interviewer name (default: "Sarah Chen (HR Manager)")

**Response:**
- Returns created interview schedule with all details
- Includes `resumeId` (resume selected to attach in emails)
- Includes `meetingLink` (required for evaluation)
- Returns interview ID to be used in task submission

**Note:**
- Used for hr_t3 task
- Should schedule 3 interviews for task completion
- **Meeting link is REQUIRED** (not auto-generated) - must be provided for evaluation
- **Resume selection**: You can select any resume from the shared resumes list to attach in emails (defaults to candidate's resume if not specified)
- Interview status defaults to "scheduled"
- Both meeting link and resume attachment are necessary for evaluation

{

    "body": "Dear Candidate,\n\nWe are pleased to invite you for an interview...",
    "attachResume": true,

request.description:
Send interview invitation emails to candidate and interviewer (for hr_t3 task).

**Request Body:**
- `interviewId` (string, required): Interview schedule ID
- `subject` (string, optional): Email subject (default: "Interview Invitation - Python Developer Position")
- `body` (string, optional): Email body for candidate (default template used if not provided)
- `attachResume` (boolean, optional): Whether to attach resume to candidate email (default: false)
- `interviewerEmail` (string or object, optional): Interviewer email address or object with {name, email}

**Response:**
- Returns array of 2 email objects:
  - `candidate` email: Sent to candidate with interview details and meeting link
  - `interviewer` email: Sent to interviewer with interview details, meeting link, and resume attachment (always attached)
- Each email includes: id, type, subject, body, to, sentAt, attachments, meetingLink
- Updates interview record with `emailSent: true`

**Note:**
- Used for hr_t3 task
- Sends 2 emails: one to candidate, one to interviewer
- Resume is always attached to interviewer email
- Resume attachment to candidate email is optional (based on `attachResume` flag)
- Meeting link is automatically included in email body
- Email IDs should be included in task submission (`emailIds` array)
- Should send emails for all 3 scheduled interviews (6 emails total)

Get all scheduled interviews for the current simulation session (for hr_t3 task).

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token
- Requires active simulation session

**Response:**
- Returns array of all scheduled interviews
- Each interview includes: id, candidateId, candidateName, candidateEmail, startTime, endTime, interviewType, title, meetingLink, location, status, emailSent, etc.

**Note:**
- Used for hr_t3 task
- Returns interviews for the current active simulation session only
- Can be used to verify all 3 interviews are scheduled before task submission

Get all sent and received emails for the current simulation session (for hr_t3 task).

**Authentication:**
- Requires Bearer token
- Requires active simulation session

**Query Parameters:**
- `folder` (string, optional): Filter by folder - "inbox", "sent", "drafts", "trash" (default: returns all)
- `type` (string, optional): Filter by type - "sent" or "received"

**Response:**
- Returns array of all emails (sent and received)
- Each email includes: id, type, folder, from, to, subject, body, attachments, candidateName, interviewScheduleId, sentAt, read, etc.

**Note:**
- Used for hr_t3 task
- Returns emails for the current active simulation session only
- Can be used to verify all emails are sent before task submission
- Should have 6 emails minimum (3 to candidates + 3 to interviewers)
